tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las: tha ma las sbyor brtan ma'i sun zlog bzhugs: 1$0000300slob dpon sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

mkha' 'gro'i sun zlog 'di la: rab lus sems 'chi ba'i mtha' dang bral: 'bring mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mas bsu bar byed: tha ma lha srin sde brgyad kyis srog dbugs len zhing bsu bar byed: de dag thams cad 'di yis zlog par 'gyur te: sun zlog tha ma las sbyor brtan ma'i zlog pa 'di bya'o: bhyo: nam mkha' g.yu yi lding khang na: nyi 'od 'bar ba'i sman gcig ma: bzhengs shig bzhengs shigs dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam bskul: dgongs shig dgongs shig bdag la dgongs: 'bod pa'i 'gro ba grangs mang yang: ha cang bde ba ma skyed cig: bos na thugs log ma mdzad cig: g.yab na le lo ma mdzad cig: las kyi sun ma zlog tu gsol: bhyo: lha klu sde brgyad la sogs pa'i: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i sun ma zlogs: brtan ma yongs kyi gtso mo ste: dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo khyod: bdud rtsi sman gtor rakta dang: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: dam la gnas shing phrin las mdzod: bhyo: gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma: ma mo yongs kyi sun ma zlog: lho yi skyi mthing ya ma skyong: btsan gyi rgyal mo'i sun ma zlog: kha rag khyung btsun dpal gyi yum: bdud kyi rgyal mo'i sun ma zlog: byang gi gser thang g.yu bun ma: gshin rje'i rgyal mo'i sun ma= gangs dkar sha med sman gcig ma: sman gyi rgyal mo'i sun ma= byang gi dbyar thang ting lo sman: 'brog srin rgyal mo'i sun ma= sman btsun ug chos dbyar mo bsil: klu yi rgyal mo'i sun ma zlog: dpal chen gsang ba'i grogs mchog ma: ri yi rgyal mo'i sun ma= skyi mthing gangs kyi la ro sman: sha za la ro'i sun ma= brtan ma'i gtso mo la ro sman: ma sang rgyal mo'i sun ma= kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong: ma bdud rgyal mo'i sun ma= legs byin gser thang yi ge'i rigs: dmu yi rgyal mo'i sun ma= g.yu yi bu mo zu le ma: gangs kyi rgyal mo'i sun ma=

na ra shel gyi sman gcig ma: ma sang rgyal mo'i sun ma= mi g.yo brtan ma'i sa 'dzin ma: bgegs kyi rgyal mo'i sun ma= 'dzam gling brtan pa'i brtan ma dang: bod khams skyong ba'i skyong ma dang: padma 'byung gnas pho nya ste: rkyen rnams zlog pa'i mthu mo che: dmag dpung skyed la gtor ma longs: byad kha phur kha zlog pa dang: snang srid lha 'dre'i sun ma zlog: bdud rtsi sman gtor rakta dang: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: bhyo: yang gcig sun ma zlog pa ni: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo ste: dkar mo spyan gcig sun ma zlog: nag mo ral gcig sun ma zlog: slob dpon srung ma'i sun ma zlog: bya ma kun gcig sun ma zlog: bhyo: yang gcig sun ma zlog pa ni: chos skyong srung ma'i sun ma zlog: ma mo rnam bzhi'i sun ma zlog: las kyi ma mo bzhi yi sun ma zlog: bse yi lha mo bzhi yi sun ma zlog: gnod sbyin phur kha zlog pa dang: dgra 'dre lha 'dre'i sun ma zlog: bdud rtsi sman gtor rakta dang: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: gnod sbyin snying 'phrog bzhi yi sun ma zlog: bka' sdod blon mo bzhi yi sun ma zlog: dmag rgyal ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: dam gnas ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: yid bskyed ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: dbugs 'phrog ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: snying 'phrog ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: las kyi ma bzhi'i sun ma zlog: ma sring brtan ma'i sun ma zlog: steng phyogs lha rnams sun ma zlog: 'og phyogs klu rnams sun ma zlog: bar snang gnyan rnams sun ma zlog: bsgrub pa'i tshogs kyi sun ma zlog: ging chen tshogs kyi sun ma zlog: dbang phyug tshogs kyi sun ma zlog: ma mo drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: 'bar ma brgyad kyi sun ma zlog: srid pa'i ma mo brgyad rnams dang: las kyi sring bzhi'i sun ma zlog: brtan skyong ma mo'i 'khor bcas kyis: tshogs dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

las kyi sun ma zlog tu gsol: byad kha phur kha zlog tu gsol: 'byung ba rnam lnga'i sun ma zlog: yi dam lha yi sun ma zlog: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dang: srung ma rnams kyi sun ma zlog: snang srid ma mo thams cad la: 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sems dang nam mkha' sha dang sa: khrag dang chu ser drod dang me: dbugs rlung 'byung ba'i mchod pa 'bul: dri chen dri chu byang chub sems: sha khrag la sogs mchod pa 'bul: mi rta glang chen rma bya'i sha: sha chen sna lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: gzugs snang sgra grags me tog dang: dge sdig la sogs mchod pa 'bul: dga' bzhi nyams kyi mchod pa 'bul: dag pa mnyam nyid mchod pa 'bul: yon chab me tog bdug spos dang: snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang: sgra snyan la sogs mchod pa 'bul: dung chen kha sbyor snod nang du: sha chen tshil chen spos rnams btang: dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi ru: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog bkod: kong bu dur khrod gzhal yas su: tshil chen zhun chen mar me gtams: mtshan ldan bkra shis ka pā lar: gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: bhandha nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du: sha chang khur ba la sogs pa: ro brgyar ldan pa'i tshogs 'khor bshams: mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā lar: 'bru bcud a mṛta yis bkang: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: mtshan ldan rgya chen mchod pa 'bul: thabs dang shes rab dkyil 'khor du: rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyi: tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs snyan par bgyis: gsungs dbyangs snyan ngag drug cu'i sgra: mchod pa rgya chen khyed la 'bul: hūm̐: mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyis: gar stabs byed cing mchod pa 'bul: rin chen khang pa yangs brtsegs dang: rin chen gser gyi bum pa dang: yid bzhin nor bu rin chen dang: rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang: bkra shis rdzas brgyad mchod pa'i tshogs: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang: bla bre 'phan gdugs dar ldi sogs:

mchod pa'i sprin phung ji snyed rnams: bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la 'bul: lha klu sde brgyad la sogs pa'i: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i sun ma zlog: mi dang mi min la sogs pa'i: byad kha phur kha zor kha rnams: byad dang rbod gtong mkhan la zlog: rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: ༈ bhyo: mdos zor sha khrag gtor ma 'dis: da lta rnal 'byor bdag cag la: sde brgyad chad pa byung ba zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa zlog: rgyal po lo yi bdun zur zlog: blon po zla ba'i dbang btsan zlog: dmag mi zhag gi dpung grangs zlog: mtshon cha dus kyi rno ngar zlog: spar kha'i skya mda' zug pa zlog: sme ba dur du chud pa zlog: sa bdag ko long gdug rtsub zlog: 'byung ba'i dgra gshed 'thab pa zlog: gza' skar dus tshes ngan pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus babs pa zlog: khram dang byad du bcugs pa zlog: hom dang spar bu'i bskor pa zlog: dgra chen bdud du langs pa zlog: ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: mi kha bra mchu thams cad zlog: chag chen nyam nga thams cad zlog: sngon bsgugs phyi nas ded pa zlog: dgra sna phung sna gyod sna zlog: nad sna rims sna yams sna zlog: dgra sri rmi ngan thams cad zlog: che sri chung sri rgan sri zlog: gzhon sri dar sri god sri zlog: dgra sri mtshon sri nad sri zlog: mdor na srid pa'i chag sgo dang: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: sdang byed dgra bo'i steng du bhyo: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlogs: bar chad bgegs kyi steng du bhyo: za 'dre phung 'dre'i steng du zlogs: dam nyams byad ma'i steng du zor:
